evidence.summary: CASC lists the China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology (中国运载火箭技术研究院) among its eight research academies. CASC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and says it researches, designs, builds and tests strategic and tactical missiles as well as launch vehicles and spacecraft.
It belongs to CASC, which describes itself as a very large state-owned enterprise and a cornerstone of China’s national security strategy.
